scripts.spm:setup: cd ios && bundle exec pod deintegrate && npx react-native spm add --yes
scripts.spm:update: cd ios && npx react-native spm update --yes
scripts.build:ios:spm: yarn spm:update && xcodebuild -project ios/FileHashExample.xcodeproj -scheme FileHashExample -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO DISABLE_MANUAL_TARGET_ORDER_BUILD_WARNING=YES CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build
scripts.run:ios:spm: sh -c 'set -e; yarn build:ios:spm; simulator="${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}"; xcrun simctl boot "$simulator" 2>/dev/null || true; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$simulator" -b; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl install "$simulator" ios/build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/FileHashExample.app; xcrun simctl launch "$simulator" preeternal.reactnativefilehash.example'
